name: seam
description: Gives a section a shaped edge, a slant, a curve, or a wave, cut from its own background so whatever is behind shows through.

attributes.name: data-shape
attributes.description: The shape of the cut edge.

attributes.name: data-flip
attributes.description: Mirror the shape horizontally, for alternating sections. A curve is symmetric and does not change.

attributes.name: data-size
attributes.description: The depth of the cut: twice the size's space step.

tokens.name: --yeti-seam-size
tokens.description: Fix the depth for every size.

a11y.notes: Decorative only; nothing changes for assistive tech. The seam adds its depth as space on a cut edge so text never sits in the cut.
